apps.subtitle: Custom .tendies wallpapers
apps.localizedDescription: Import custom .tendies wallpapers, queue your favorites, and apply them to PosterBoard. Features a live activity log and a light blue glass design. Requires a working App Group entitlement and a compatible iOS version; device compatibility is unverified. Back up your device before applying.

versions.localizedDescription: New light blue glass design, app icon, and detailed live application activity.
